title: NF is Consistent
judgment_notes: Consistency of NF (Holmes-Wilshaw 1503.01406 cited); blueprint formalizes the hard part with its own restructured proof.

source.citation: M. Randall Holmes, Sky Wilshaw, NF is Consistent (arXiv 1503.01406)
source.scope: the hard part: construction of a model of tangled type theory (TTT), from which Con(NF) follows
source.evidence: blueprint intro: "We give a self-contained account of a version of the proof of Holmes and Wilshaw \cite{con-nf} that Quine's set theory New Foundations is consistent ... written in a style that is particularly amenable to the formalisation in Lean"; restructured proof, not statement by statement.
